notes.title: Version 0.3.0 is live!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] - Faster and more beautiful!
[*] - Added auto exposure on some maps to improve visibility in dark areas and provide more realism.
[*] - Fixed slow performance issue that caused the game to close upon opening.
[*] - Added new achievements.
[*] - Aliens now also receive critical damage when shot in the head.
[*] - Upon completing the mission of the map, the game ends (previously, it was only ending on time).
[/list]
